title: Civitai outlines separate .com and .red entry points
summary: On 2026-04-13, Civitai published an article describing Civitai.com and Civitai.red as two access points and indicating a forthcoming direction for them. The link establishes the existence of that first-party announcement, but the sealed evidence does not provide enough detail to state the operational distinction or user impact.
research_notes: .com — SFW, карты, memberships и Creator Program; .red — полный каталог, NSFW и crypto. Аккаунт, загрузки и follows общие.
